clause_text: Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving thirty days prior written notice to the other party.
The company may terminate this Agreement at any time without notice and without compensation.
The total liability of either party shall not exceed the fees paid under this Agreement in the preceding twelve months.
The service provider shall be liable for all direct, indirect, incidental and consequential damages without any monetary limitation.
Each Party shall keep confidential all non-public information disclosed by the other Party for a period of three years.
The receiving party shall maintain confidentiality forever without any exception or limitation.
Each Party shall indemnify the other Party only for losses arising from its breach, negligence, fraud, or wilful misconduct, subject to a reasonable liability cap.
The purchaser shall indemnify and keep indemnified the seller against all losses, claims, damages and expenses without any limit.
Neither Party shall be liable for delay or failure caused by events beyond reasonable control, provided prompt written notice is given.
The seller may terminate the agreement due to force majeure without refund, interest, compensation, or liability to the purchaser.
